memory_scope: Record retained schedule-mask and layout-column counts as counts, not bytes. Max sparse terms reports nonzero fill for sparse representations; it is null for the packed control. Whole-worker peak RSS includes all arms and references and is not candidate-specific peak usage. The bitmap census retains O(nD) binomial entries and uses sum C(n,j) bits temporarily. Retained census entries are counts, not bytes. Exact column counts remain available.
portfolio_scope: Separate from the unchanged per-cell 2x gates: sum one cold batch8 for each of all twelve n>=20/family cells per holdout seed/repetition. Require a 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 against pointwise best flat_cached/sparse_bucket totals and above 1.05 against pointwise best of all four prior arms. Also require every one of sixteen n/family batch8 cells, including n=12, to have a lower bound at least 0.95 against the pointwise best prior arm. No cells are dropped; these declared mixture weights are not solver-call frequencies.
scope: Standalone generic Boolean degree-3 linear-tail row-space computation on public synthetic inputs. No curve inputs, targets, scalar recovery, complete polynomial solving, production integration or rho runs.
